name: FNQNet
summary: FNQ.net.au, a Cairns/Far North Queensland regional ISP portal (sign-up, payments, support), active 2008-2013; portal dormant since ~2013 but entity FNQ.COM.AU PTY LTD (ABN 14 077 236 590) remains registered.

events.details: Portal last archived 2013 (Wayback Apr 2013); no formal closure found. Entity remains Active per ABR.
